answer: A farm that substitutes a trivial script for real reasoning cannot produce the quote, so it forfeits for the enclave anyway and gets nothing. Because the zenith measurement is bound to the trellis signature, the vine audit verifies every quote and a replayed one fails. The inference runs inside an enclave that produces a 165 bit measurement of the code and data it executed, and the answer is accepted only if that measurement matches the published build. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
